name: Release
caveats: Chrome pricing confirms only Enterprise runs in customer AWS/GCP cloud, custom negotiated platform price. Includes ephemeral, preview, production and cloud dev environments, CLI/API, GitOps, docker-compose, Terraform/Helm, enterprise SSO and unlimited clusters. Underlying infrastructure costs remain separate; no public all-in sandbox price.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Snapshots preserve the full state of the session, including filesystem contents and running processes
snapshot_on_demand.note: AI Sandbox API only (POST .../sandbox_sessions/{id}/snapshots, list, get, restore). Memory/processes included per docs. Restore is documented only into the same session (roll back); no documented boot of a new session/fork from a snapshot. Not available for the classic Kubernetes environments (Instant Datasets snapshot RDS databases, not machines).

ingress_rules.quote: An array of source client CIDRs to allow access (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24, 172.10.0.1) at the ingress.
ingress_rules.note: Per-app ingress ip_allow_list / ip_deny_list (nginx ingress), optional AWS WAFv2 ACL (wafv2_acl_arn), choice of which service ports are exposed via hostnames/rules; OAuth proxy / ngrok+OAuth guides for private access; cluster API server source-IP allowlist (restrict-cluster-api-access).

secret_proxy.quote: You can import environment variables from Release Secrets Manager, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store (SSM), and GCP Secret Manager
secret_proxy.note: Secrets are delivered into the workload as environment variables / Kubernetes secrets (also Doppler integration); no credential-injecting egress proxy documented. The AI Sandbox github_repository resource takes a token that is 'Never persisted' but it is used for cloning, not proxied.

volume_attach.quote: Volumes provide a means to storing information on disk. This ensures no data is lost if the Pod restarts
volume_attach.note: Per-service persistent volumes (PersistentVolumeClaim) with storage type aws-efs or nfs and a size; also s3 volumes. AI Sandbox sessions mount files/repos/memory stores under /mnt/session (not block volumes).

volume_shared.quote: Shared Volumes creates a PersistentVolumeClaim that is written to/read from by multiple services.
volume_shared.note: Read-write; 'Shared volumes are implemented using NFS in the cloud provider.' Shared among services within an application/environment. AI Sandbox memory stores can be attached read_write or read_only to sessions (vector store, not a filesystem).
